source: MoviOdds reported results; kickoff checked against closing

protocol.freshSelection: Fixed SHA256(v8:fixture_id) order of complete source-reported BO5 events absent from old snapshot, finished before declared collection end, with >=30 prior old-snapshot matches per player. Verify actual kickoff with closing; no filtering by winner, total or model correctness. Sealed labels not read by model selection.
protocol.context: Original eight causal score features plus causal league frequencies, player last-30 score summaries and target frequencies, shrunken H2H, with all outcomes available strictly before verified kickoff minus one minute. League-only causal reference, not a 50% straw baseline.
protocol.selection: Select candidate on pooled historical outer-fold Brier per target; calibration-only shrinkage per fold; freeze final selection manifest and model hashes before opening fresh confirmation labels. New-day confirmation is retrospective temporal holdout, not prospective paper betting.
protocol.checks: Report Brier, log loss, ECE, discrimination, confidence-selected accuracy with sample counts; paired 3-hour-block bootstrap versus league reference, adjusted for 14 targets. Do not promote on high hit rate alone. Confirmation requires >=500 cases, >=12 observed hours, positive Brier improvement beyond adjusted interval, improved log loss, ECE<0.08; multi-day forward confirmation and executable odds still required for operational reliability.
limits: Old archive has been examined before; historical search remains exploratory

protocol.freshFeatureSnapshot: Use only the old result snapshot collected 2026-11-04T23:59:32.157Z for ALL confirmation features. No fresh confirmation outcomes are used as features, training, calibration or selection inputs. Actual event list/quotes were not prospectively captured; this is retrospective frozen-snapshot temporal confirmation.
